intent: Let a newly installed lyricanki appear on the phone. Focus Owner hides every package absent from the allowlist, so lyricanki installed as installed=true hidden=true: missing from the launcher and from `pm list packages`, and `am start` reported the activity did not exist even though dumpsys listed its MAIN/LAUNCHER filter.
scope: Non-goal: night curfew. lyricanki is a day-list app only.
Non-goal: any change to enforcement logic.
changes: Added com.kuhy.lyricanki to the 'kuhy's own apps' block of WHITELIST, alphabetically.
Regenerated policy.json via `python3 -m python_pkg.focus_policy --redact-home`; the diff is the single added entry in allowed_packages.

Dropped com.android.launcher3 and com.android.camera2 from SYSTEM_NEVER_DISABLE. Both are strict supersets of entries already present (com.android.launcher, com.android.camera) and that list is prefix-matched, so coverage is unchanged; this kept config.sh under the 250-line cap without weakening the policy. com.android.settings was NOT removed: its only shorter match is com.android.se, an accidental substring rather than intent.

verification.evidence: launcher3 covered: True, camera2 covered: True, settings covered: True - prefix semantics identical before and after the two removals.
release signer 9dcc2e6c...f846 matched the installed APK's signer, so `adb install -r` was an in-place upgrade with no uninstall. 'Success'.
User 0: admin=com.kuhy.focus_owner/.FocusDeviceAdminReceiver,DeviceOwner - Device Owner survived the upgrade.

verification.command: adb shell dumpsys package <pkg> | grep hidden
verification.evidence: com.kuhy.lyricanki hidden=false (was true). Regression spot-checks: com.kuhy.workout_app hidden=false, org.fossify.phone hidden=false.

risks: Reinstalling the Device Owner app is unrecoverable if the signature ever differs: DO cannot be re-provisioned on an unrooted Pixel without a factory reset. Mitigated by comparing the keystore's SHA-256 against the installed APK's before building, and by pulling the live versionCode 2 APK as a rollback artifact first.
A misparsed allowlist could hide the dialer or launcher. Checked explicitly after install rather than assuming.
rollback: adb install -r <scratchpad>/focus_owner-installed-vc2.apk (pulled from the device before the upgrade; same signer, so it reinstalls in place).
git revert the config.sh + policy.json commit and regenerate.
After rollback confirm: dpm list-owners still reports DeviceOwner, and org.fossify.phone is hidden=false.
